about: What follows phase 1. The evaluation has decided a phase 2 (the replay set first, then the cuts it grades, every body under the 5,000 tokens a compaction keeps, the rewording) and that decision records stop being written at the defaults. R-rop-9 says automate-dev-flow resumes once this evaluation is done; letting phase 2 go first would amend it.
question: What runs next: phase 2 first with automate-dev-flow waiting until it is done (amends R-rop-9), automate-dev-flow resuming now as R-rop-9 says with phase 2 after it, or the records change built first as one small change and then automate-dev-flow, with phase 2 after?

defines.definition: The follow-on to this program that the evaluation has decided: build a set of replayed sessions to grade risky cuts by, then make the cuts, bring every skill body under 5,000 tokens and reword what phase 1 left.
A small file the AI writes when it makes a call in one of eighteen listed areas, or before it stops to ask at one of five listed situations, with the answer recorded beside it.
